# joule AI

> joule AI is coming soon. its tagline is "less managing, more doing". this site is a one-page waitlist.

site: https://jouleai.vercel.app/
contact: tryjoule.ai@gmail.com

## home page

joule AI
less managing, more doing
coming soon

the page has one form: enter your email and press "join waitlist".

## after you join

you're on the list, and the page offers 6 optional multiple-choice questions that help shape joule AI. every question can be skipped. the questions are:

1. what best describes you?
2. which browser do you use most?
3. what gets in the way the most?
4. why haven't productivity apps stuck for you?
5. what should joule do for you?
6. if joule nailed it, what would you pay?

## invites

after you join, you get a personal invite link. when someone joins the waitlist through it, you get 2 months free.

## questions

### what is joule AI?

joule AI is coming soon. its tagline is "less managing, more doing".

### is joule AI available yet?

not yet. joule AI is coming soon, and the waitlist is open.

### how do i join the waitlist?

enter your email at the top of this page and press "join waitlist".

### what happens after i join?

you're on the list, and you can answer 6 optional multiple-choice questions that help shape joule AI.

### what do i get for inviting someone?

after you join, you get a personal invite link. when someone joins the waitlist through it, you get 2 months free.

### how do i contact joule AI?

email tryjoule.ai@gmail.com.
